scope: All84 larger prototype owner sheets individually inspected against their own registered source, four orbit and four street views. Scores are negative/provisional reviews, not approvals. No naturally selected size2..4 world or full consistency/state acceptance exists. These decisions do not alter released artwork or the canonical1831-model review file.
